purpose: Teach: 蛇足/悪し/男前/わが子/惨め/見分ける/読み取る/老若男女

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の発言、蛇足が多すぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku — you run your mouth way too much sometimes, don't you.
lines.style: Dry, teasing drawl. Leans back slightly. Casual certainty — she knows exactly what she's saying and isn't worried about it landing. Quick pace on the setup, slight pause before the closer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、悪しき癖直せよ、桜
lines.en: You're one to talk. When are you going to quit that annoying habit of yours, Sakura.
lines.style: Mirrors her dryness but with a softer edge underneath. Mild protest, not defensive. Speaking as an equal, not lecturing. Light almost-smile in the voice — he's playing too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、男前だなって彼女に言われてたな
lines.en: Your girlfriend told me you're pretty handsome, you know.
lines.style: Casual tease with genuine pleasure underneath. Slight uptick at the end — she's watching for his reaction. Warm mockery. Delivered like she's sharing harmless gossip she probably shouldn't.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、わが子に対するお母さんみたいに弟可愛がるな、桜
lines.en: Come on, you're acting like a mom fussing over her kid. Cut it out, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-attack with embarrassment underneath. Slightly faster than usual — deflecting. Not genuinely angry, just mortified at being called out for caring. The smallest laugh buried in it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストで惨めな点取ってたな
lines.en: By the way — remember that pathetic test score you got last week?
lines.style: Casual pivot to offense. Sing-song teasing in the opening. Matter-of-fact and merciless. The tone of someone who's keeping mental notes and enjoys using them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本物と偽物を見分ける目あるな、桜
lines.en: That's rich coming from you. You've got a real talent for spotting what's genuine and what isn't, Sakura.
lines.style: Lighter now — genuine praise with the wryness still there. The words land with real weight because of how little he usually compliments directly. Slight warmth on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生の機嫌を読み取るのが上手いな
lines.en: You're pretty good at reading the room, especially when it comes to teachers.
lines.style: Genuine approval. Warm and observant. Spoken with respect — he means this one. Slower, more deliberate than the jabs. The voice of someone noticing something real about her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で老若男女に大人気だったな、桜
lines.en: Everyone was all over you at the culture festival, weren't they. Everyone from little kids to grandparents.
lines.style: Admiring with genuine warmth. Spoken close, like a private observation. Soft openness. The kind of thing he wouldn't say if others were listening — this is just for her. Slight fondness trailing at the end.
